create_map_builder: create a MapBuilder instance with configurable map size, resolution, and obstacle thresholds for SLAM mapping
update_map_with_pointcloud: update the occupancy map using a point cloud observation in the global frame to detect obstacles
update_semantic_map: update the semantic map with point cloud data and semantic category channels for environment classification
add_obstacle_to_map: add an obstacle at a specific map location by setting the occupancy threshold value
convert_real_to_map_coords: convert real world metric coordinates to map pixel coordinates using the real2map transformation method
